description: This file defines the class OAuth2ClientsViewDetail, a view component for displaying details of OAuth2 client configurations within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for setting metadata, view types based on grant types, and rendering the display.

classes.name: OAuth2ClientsViewDetail
classes.description: A view class responsible for displaying detailed information about OAuth2 client entries, including handling different grant types and rendering logic.

methods.name: getMetaDataFile
methods.description: Retrieves the metadata file for the view and sets the view type accordingly.

methods.name: setViewType
methods.description: Determines the specific view type and form name based on the OAuth2 client's allowed grant type.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Prepares the display by setting form name and invokes the parent display method.

search-terms: PHP class for OAuth2 client detail view
